line: Jaime.
notes: Jaime (English) from 1:05:07.1; heard within three minutes.

line: Boys kick a football on a dry field. Girls in wide-brimmed hats laugh, holding hands.
Villagers lean in around a Proclaimer on a rock.
A small boy throws up his arms and grins. Donna Sauñe.
Alfredo by a lake. Morgan.
Sunlight breaks over dark mountain ridges.
notes: Unsubtitled sound 1:06:21-1:06:35 (singing?). Narrator to confirm describing over it.

line: Alfredo Fajardo.
notes: Assumed speaker of 864-868 (he gestures on screen at 1:06:42). Confirm.

line: The valley, framed by wooden posts. Alfredo, in shadow.
Rómulo lives forever.
notes: On-screen subtitle builds word by word (Rómulo / Rómulo lives / Rómulo lives forever.); read once as the finished line.

line: A turquoise screen above a band of bright woven cloth. Title: The Voice of Rómulo.
Faith Comes By Hearing now provides Scripture in thousands of languages. More than one billion people still don't have access to Scripture in a language and format they understand.
